ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Child Care Funding Freeze on Minnesota Families
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of the federal child care funding freeze on Minnesota families, including the number of families affected and the potential consequences.
ideas.angle: The human impact of the funding freeze

What are the potential consequences for these families?
